summary: 063 keeps the final corrective scope coherent and proves most decisive facts, but it is not yet Proposal-ready. The required archive readiness ordering is correct, while the existing execution owner capable of running that self-check before structural prepare is not proven: current invokeSingleAction prepares before Guidance resolution and callback execution. The canonical Explore also still narrates Reviewer/Owner revision chronology instead of converging fully to current rationale.
